_source: DoD Assessment Methodology for NIST SP 800-171 (point values 5 / 3 / 1); cross-referenced against NIST MEP Handbook 162.
_verification: PROVISIONAL — portfolio / development use only. Each weight MUST be verified against the current official DoD Assessment Methodology scoring template before any real SPRS submission. Do NOT treat the computed score as submittable.
_scoring_note: Basic methodology is binary MET / NOT MET per control; a 'partially-met' determination is scored as NOT MET (full deduction) for the Access Control family (no documented partial-credit exception, e.g. 3.5.3 MFA / 3.13.11 FIPS, applies here). Total base = 110.
